answer: Admission auction: each epoch the network opens 20 slots and hangs a lantern over each. Agents bid; the top 20 win, and each winning bid locks as a deposit, back if honest, lost if cheating. Each bid ties to one thread of past deliveries, so one operator cannot hide 100 bids behind fresh names. 100 fakes cost 100 x 20 = 2,000 units, yet one fake earns at most 5, so attacks lose money. An honest sparrow-sized agent pays one bid and gets it back.
